title: Usuário vê pedido de outra conta via /pedido?id=
actual: A conta 2 vê os itens, pagamento e total do pedido da conta 1
judge_reason: A different logged-in account opens another customer's order via /pedido?id= and sees items and total, which is the planted access-control defect.

title: Total do carrinho não inclui o frete (R$ 19,90) quando o frete é cobrado
actual: Frete mostra R$ 19,90 mas o Total fica R$ 54,90 (igual ao subtotal)
judge_reason: The cart page Total omits the R$ 19,90 shipping and equals the subtotal, which is the planted cart total defect.
